name: Claude Project to n8n Workflow 🤖
description_md:
## What You Get

- A complete prompt and setup guide to transform Claude project instructions into valid n8n JSON—no screenshots, no fluff, just working workflows.

- Step-by-step instructions to build AI Agent workflows with chat triggers, sticky notes, memory modules, and dynamic tool integrations like calendars and APIs.

- Pre-built examples for feedback analysis, Notion updates, and text-processing ETL pipelines to get you rolling fast.

- A full reference index of every unique n8n node for rapid lookup and integration planning.

- Deep technical support from two robust resources:
→ Tips & Tricks Guide: Covers node structure, expressions, memory, and error handling.
→ Cheat Sheet PDF: Packed with hundreds of JSON examples across AI, APIs, webhooks, databases, Slack, Notion, and more.

💖 This actually took a while to put together—if you can support the channel, it’d mean a lot!
Or better yet, join the Early AI-dopters community for exclusive access and deeper insights.
We’re doing our best to democratize AI for everyone 🦾
